title: Croatian Burger
description: A vegetarian twist on the classic burger, topped with a Croatian-inspired slaw made with aerated cheese.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or grill to medium-high heat.
Form the Croatian burger patties and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the buns by grilling or broiling for 2-3 minutes.
Shred the aerated cheese and mix with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Assemble the burgers by spreading a layer of the cheese slaw on the bottom bun, followed by the cooked burger patty, and finishing with the top bun.
